products.name: Product Coast Muse Burnout Velvet Long Sleeve Maxi Dress With Gold Trim olive

got.name: Coast Muse Burnout Velvet Long Sleeve Maxi Dress With Gold Trim
got.desc: Burnout velvet construction creates a floral pattern that shifts between matt and lustrous surfaces as the fabric catches the light - the dense, short pile absorbs depth in a way printed fabric simply cannot replicate. A high mock neck and full-length sleeves give the silhouette a refined, covered-up quality, with the gold trim detail at the waist drawing the eye inward as a focal point. The gathered, twisted waist is fixed in place rather than adjustable - it creates a draped, sculpted effect through the midriff that falls into a sleek maxi skirt with a subtle asymmetric hem. Gold hardware at the waist ties in the trim detail and adds a considered finish that reads as jewellery-adjacent - meaning you can keep accessories minimal without the look feeling unfinished. The skirt falls close to the body through the hip and thigh before the asymmetric hem introduces a slight split, allowing movement without compromising the polished overall line. This dress sits comfortably alongside the more structured pieces in a wardrobe - it doesn't need layering to hold its own. The long sleeves and high neck make it a strong choice for occasions where the setting demands something considered: a winter wedding, a black-tie dinner, or an evening at the races when the temperature drops. Style it as the model does, with strappy heeled sandals that keep the ankle visible and let the asymmetric hem do its work. A small structured clutch and drop earrings are all it needs.
